ns2:section.sectionText: This course brings together data analytics, data visualization and introductory statistical methods to make sense of social problems. Together, we are going to learn and use R-studio in this class (students are not expected to have any R backgrounds). In addition to focus on the application of statistics in sociology, SOC 280 will prepare students for further rigorous quantitative, computational, and data analytics courses in the future. This course will be administrated mostly asynchronously with some synchronous lectures throughout the semester.
